name: std::swap(std::function)

declarations.code:
template <class R, class... Args>

void swap(std::function<R(Args...)> &lhs, std::function<R(Args...)> &rhs) noexcept;

intro: Overloads the std::swap algorithm for std::function. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 polymorphic function wrappers whose states to swap

examples.output:
foo("f1", 1)
bar("f2", 2)
std::swap(f1, f2);
bar("f1", 1)
foo("f2", 2)
